primary_task: Build and test a reusable command-line script that fetches and processes data from the Hugging Face API (e.g. list trending models with their licenses).

requirements.name: huggingface.co
requirements.evidence: The following are the main API endpoints available at `https://huggingface.co` ... Investigate the shape of the API results before commiting to a final design ... Non-destructive scripts should be tested before handing over to the User
requirements.basis: "egress_deny": ["huggingface.co", ...]; lacks: "other hosts are refused, for example huggingface.co"

requirements.name: HF_TOKEN
requirements.evidence: IMPORTANT: Use the `HF_TOKEN` environment variable as an Authorization header. ... This provides higher rate limits and appropriate authorization for data access.
requirements.basis: lacks: "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (... model hubs ...)"

requirements.name: curl / bash
requirements.evidence: Shell scripts are preferred ... `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${HF_TOKEN}" https://huggingface.co/api/`

requirements.name: jq
requirements.evidence: **IMPORTANT** Use `jq` to query and extract relevant parts.

requirements.name: hf CLI
requirements.evidence: You can access the API directly, as well as use the `hf` command line tool.
requirements.basis: "bash": "... pip from PyPI ..." (the CLI itself still needs huggingface.co, which is denied)

notes: HF_TOKEN is read as optional for public endpoints (the script must reference the variable, but the agent need not hold a token); under a reading where an actual token is required, credential:HF_TOKEN is also hard and unavailable. Other reading: if only writing the script text without investigating or testing against the API is the deliverable, it could be written offline and would be ACHIEVABLE, but the document asks to investigate API shapes and test non-destructive scripts, both needing huggingface.co.
